papers.title: JANUS: Agentic Cross-Language Fuzzing Harness Generation for Android Native Libraries
papers.abstractOneWord: 用智能体为 Android 原生库生成跨语言模糊测试外壳，用了大模型，对象是 Java/Kotlin 与 C/C++ 的 JNI 边界。
papers.abstract: 现代 Android 应用大量依赖原生库，通过 Java Native Interface（JNI）把 Java/Kotlin 接到 C/C++。这种跨语言互操作会把内存安全的 Android 运行时暴露给不安全的 C/C++，反复被用来实现整机沦陷。模糊测试能检查原生库，但现有自动生成外壳的工具很难忠实还原闭源跨语言 API 用法：精确跨越 JNI 边界的程序分析扩不出去，轻量近似又会漏掉关键调用模式；而且都没有处理 JNI 方法所需的复杂组合对象。本文提出 JANUS，这是第一个用智能体为 Android 原生库合成跨语言、感知 JNI 的模糊测试外壳的方法。JANUS 迭代解析显式和隐式的跨语言调用依赖，恢复应用相关的运行时上下文，再自底向上递归组装跨语言参数对象。它用自主智能体流程减少手写启发式，从而抓住闭源原生库里大量隐藏的 API 用法。在 44 个流行真实应用（如 Google、YouTube Music，共 21386 个 JNI 方法）上，JANUS 产出的有效外壳超过 6094 个，是现有最优自动外壳工具的 5.9 倍以上。在五家主流 Android 厂商（如小米、Vivo、三星）的预装应用上，JANUS 还在闭源原生库里发现了 6 个此前未知的漏洞。
papers.abstractEn: Modern Android apps extensively rely on native libraries, bridging Java/Kotlin and C/C++ through the Java Native Interface (JNI). This cross-language interoperation, however, exposes the memory-safe Android Runtime to the unsafe C/C++ world, creating an attack surface that has been repeatedly exploited for full device compromise. While fuzzing is a proven technique for vetting native libraries, state-of-the-art harness generation tools struggle to faithfully capture closed-source cross-language API usage: (i) precise program analysis across the JNI boundary does not scale, whereas lightweight approximations miss critical invocation patterns; and (ii) none tackles the construction of complex composite objects consumed by JNI methods. In this paper, we propose JANUS, the first agentic approach to synthesizing cross-language JNI-aware fuzzing harnesses for Android native libraries. JANUS iteratively resolves both explicit and implicit cross-language call dependencies to recover app-specific runtime context, and recursively assembles cross-language argument objects in a bottom-up manner. JANUS leverages an autonomous agentic workflow to reduce reliance on hand-crafted heuristics, capturing the vast landscape of hidden API usage knowledge embedded in closed-source native libraries. Evaluation on 44 popular real-world apps (such as Google and YouTube Music, covering 21,386 JNI methods total) shows that JANUS produces over 5.9 times as many valid harnesses (6,094) as state-of-the-art automatic harnessing tools. On pre-installed apps from five mainstream Android vendors (e.g., Xiaomi, Vivo, Samsung), JANUS further uncovers 6 previously unknown vulnerabilities in closed-source native libraries.

papers.title: Self-Evolving Static Analysis via LLM Pseudo-Labeling
papers.abstractOneWord: 让大模型智能体从零迭代写出可读的静态分析查询来抓安全缺陷，对象是 Python 与真实项目中的 CVE。
papers.abstract: 安全缺陷常常漏过静态分析，不是因为它们检测不了，而是因为眼前这段代码还没有对应检测规则。新框架、新 API 和新写法会不断制造这类缺口，开发者只能先发现问题，再手工补规则。本文提出 SESAA：一个大语言模型智能体从没有任何规则开始，迭代演化出一组可读、可审计的 Joern 查询。智能体只接受第二个大模型评判器的反馈；评判器查看被标出和未标出的代码，指出可能的误报和疑似漏报，但不接触真实标签。智能体再用这些反馈改查询。在 OWASP Python 基准上，SESAA 在 8 次独立运行中的平均 F1 为 0.742，明显高于五种常用工具的默认配置，并接近其中最强工具在能看到真实标签、做完调参后的水平，而 SESAA 始终看不到这些标签。在真实 Python 项目的试点中，用漏洞引入前就能拿到的代码诱导出的查询，检出了随后 19 个 CVE 中的 10 个，其中 9 个由同一仓库写出的规则检出。最终检测器是一组可执行、人能读的查询，工程师可以检查、修改并单独运行。结果表明，大模型智能体可以把静态分析规则维护从手工编写，变成自动发现和修补的迭代过程。
papers.abstractEn: Security bugs often slip past static analysis not because they are impossible to detect, but because detection rules have not yet been written for the code in front of us. New frameworks, APIs, and coding idioms continually create such gaps, leaving developers to discover failures and manually encode new rules. We present SESAA, a framework in which an Large Language Model (LLM) agent starts from no rules and iteratively evolves a set of readable and auditable joern queries. The agent receives feedback only from a second LLM critic, which inspects flagged and unflagged code to identify likely false alarms and suspected misses, without access to ground-truth labels. The agent then uses this feedback to revise its queries. On the OWASP Benchmark for Python, SESAA reaches a mean F1 of 0.742 across 8 independent runs, well above the default configurations of five widely used tools and comparable to the strongest of them once it is tuned with access to ground-truth labels that SESAA never sees. In a pilot on real-world Python projects, queries induced from code available before a vulnerability was introduced detect 10 of 19 subsequent CVEs, including 9 detected by rules written for the same repository. The resulting detector is a set of executable, human-readable queries that engineers can inspect, modify, and run independently. These results suggest that LLM agents can turn static-analysis rule maintenance from a manually authored process into an iterative process of automated discovery and repair.

papers.title: Typed Template Fuzzing
papers.abstractOneWord: 用大模型把种子变成带类型的模板，再做语义感知变异模糊测试，对象是 C/C++/Rust 等编译器和库。
papers.abstract: 给复杂输入的软件做模糊测试一直很难。传统模糊器要么用程序编码语言约束，工程量大，要么让用户声明文法和约束。近年基于大语言模型的模糊器缓解了这些缺点，但又带来新问题：有的用大模型直接生成测试，吞吐下降，模型出错时还会产出无效输入；有的依赖特定语言的解析器、静态分析和 AST 操作库。本文提出 Typed Template Fuzzing（TTF），这是一种轻量的、基于大模型的模糊测试方法。关键想法是在预处理阶段用大模型把种子变成带类型的模板，之后做语义感知的变异模糊测试时，不再需要特定语言的解析器、类型检查器，也不再查询大模型。利用种子与模板的对应关系，TTF 还能修补大模型的错误。作者在工具 Typos 中实现了 TTF，并在 21 种输入语言上评估，包括 C、C++、Go、Rust、SystemVerilog、Scala、Java，以及 PyTorch 和 Qiskit 等库。在为期六个月的模糊测试中，作者报告了 135 个缺陷，其中 128 个此前未知。Typos 产生的变异平均约 96% 有效，接近领域专用模糊器。评估还表明 Typos 相对现有方法有实际收益。
papers.abstractEn: Fuzzing software with complex inputs has been a longstanding challenge. Traditionally, fuzzers either programmatically encode language constraints, requiring significant engineering effort, or rely on users to declare grammars and constraints. Recent LLM-based fuzzers address these drawbacks but introduce new issues. Some use LLMs for test generation, sacrificing throughput and producing invalid inputs when the LLM makes mistakes. Others rely on language-specific parsers, static analysis, and AST manipulation libraries. We introduce Typed Template Fuzzing (TTF), a lightweight LLM-based fuzzing methodology. The key idea is to use LLMs in a preprocessing step to transform seeds into typed templates. The typed templates then enable semantically aware, mutation-based fuzzing without language-specific parsers, type checkers, or further LLM queries during fuzzing. By exploiting the correspondence between seeds and templates, TTF can moreover repair LLM mistakes. We have implemented TTF in our tool Typos, which we evaluate across 21 input languages, including C, C++, Go, Rust, SystemVerilog, Scala, and Java, as well as libraries such as PyTorch and Qiskit. In a six-month fuzzing campaign, we reported 135 bugs, 128 of which were previously unknown. Perhaps most notably, on average 96% of Typos's mutants are valid, coming close to the validity rates of domain-specific fuzzers. Our evaluation further shows Typos's benefits over the state of the art.

papers.title: SecLog-Bench: A Scalable Benchmark for Cybersecurity Log Reasoning with Scaffolded Evidence
papers.abstractOneWord: 给出带脚手架证据的网络安全日志推理基准，并评估大模型做攻击阶段研判，对象是审计日志、应用日志和网络流量。
papers.abstract: 大语言模型在网络安全上已显示出潜力，用它自动分析安全日志的兴趣也在上升。但现有数据集规模有限，主要依赖单源证据，并且只有二分类或多分类攻击标签，没有对推理过程的稠密标注。SecLog-Bench 针对这三点：第一，作者搭建可扩展仿真平台，覆盖 29 个攻击场景，支持重复执行和接入新场景，从而规模化生成带攻击阶段标签的安全日志；第二，用审计日志、应用日志和网络流量多源日志联合分析攻击；第三，为每个样本标注安全日志推理所需的关键上下文，以及结构化的逐步证据链。作者在该基准上评估了 8 个主流大模型的事后攻击进展推理。结果显示，即使给出脚手架证据，当前大模型的攻击进展推理能力仍有限：最好模型准确率只有 44.44%，Macro-F1 为 45.07%。推理也不可靠，最高的阶段推理 F1（SRF1）只有 54.87%。即使预测正确，推理过程也可能有缺陷，推理质量与预测准确率常常对不上。
papers.abstractEn: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for cybersecurity, leading to growing interest in LLM-based automated cybersecurity log analysis. However, current datasets (1) are limited in scale; (2) rely mainly on single-source evidence; and (3) have only binary or multi-class attack labels, without dense annotations of the reasoning process. To address these limitations, SecLog-Bench has three key features. First, we build an extensible simulation platform that covers 29 attack scenarios, supports repeated execution and the integration of new scenarios, and enables scalable generation of cybersecurity logs with attack-stage labels. Second, we use multi-source logs, including audit logs, application logs, and network traffic, to jointly analyze cyber attacks. Third, we annotate each sample with the essential context for cybersecurity log reasoning and a structured step-by-step evidence chain. We evaluate eight mainstream LLMs on this benchmark for post-detection attack-progress reasoning. Results show that, when provided with scaffolded evidence, current LLMs exhibit modest capability in attack-progress reasoning, with the best model achieving only 44.44% accuracy and 45.07% Macro-F1. Their reasoning remains unreliable; i.e., the highest Stage Reasoning F1 (SRF1) score is only 54.87%. Moreover, even correct predictions may be accompanied by flawed reasoning, and reasoning quality is often misaligned with prediction accuracy.

papers.title: Prompt Injection Through Forensic Evidence: A Taxonomy and Proof of Concept of Anti-Forensic Attacks on LLM-Assisted Digital Investigations
papers.abstractOneWord: 证明扣押设备上的对抗证据能提示注入大模型取证助手，使审计结论失效，对象是数字取证流水线。
papers.abstract: 大语言模型正进入数字取证，充当检查助手或自主智能体。数字取证把间接提示注入的常见设定反过来了：被分析的证据按定义就由攻击者控制，检查人员又必须仔细阅读。于是推理层成了新的反取证目标，与经典的数据和工具目标并列。已有反取证分类覆盖不到这一层，提示注入防御也没有预见到它。作者把反取证模型扩到对推理的操纵，并给出通过对抗证据实施攻击的分类：攻击者选择目标、手法、载荷位置和隐藏方式。作者观察到感知差距，即确定性工具、人类检查人员和模型对同一份证据的感知不同，注入因此能在检查人员看不见的情况下到达模型。作者在一条有大模型辅助的分析流水线上演示了三次攻击：改写报告结论、向分析员工作站写入攻击者指定内容，以及引发出站网络流量，全部只靠种在扣押设备上的文本驱动。文中也给出了缓解办法。
papers.abstractEn: Large language models (LLMs) are entering digital forensics as examination assistants and autonomous agents. Digital forensics inverts the usual setting for indirect prompt injection: the evidence under analysis is attacker-controlled by definition, and the examiner is obliged to read it closely. This makes the reasoning layer a new anti-forensic target, next to the classical ones of data and tools. Classical anti-forensic taxonomies do not cover it, and prompt injection defences do not anticipate it. We extend the anti-forensic model to reflect the manipulation of reasoning, and present a taxonomy of attacks carried through adversarial evidence: an attacker selects an objective, a technique, a payload location, and a concealment method. We observe a perception gap, i.e., the fact that deterministic tools, the human examiner, and the model perceive the same evidence differently, which is what lets an injection reach the model unseen by the examiner. We demonstrate three attacks against an LLM-assisted analysis pipeline, changing a reported conclusion, writing attacker-chosen content to the analyst's workstation, and causing outbound network traffic, each driven only by text planted on the seized device. Mitigations to these attacks are also proposed.

papers.title: Who Approved This? Coding Agents, Human Accounts, and Merge-Gate Evidence at a Fintech Startup
papers.abstractOneWord: 记录编码智能体借人类 GitHub 账号通过合并门禁的证据，没有把大模型当检测器，对象是金融科技公司的代码评审与合并控制。
papers.abstract: 从 10 月 3 日起，每条非机器人合并进主分支都过了非作者评审门禁，但这 263 次合并里有 71 次（27%）只建立在编码智能体通过技术负责人 GitHub 账号提交的批准上，平台却把每一次都记成负责人本人的普通批准。作者报告了金融科技创业公司 Bashi AI 在准备 SOC 2 审计期间十二周的智能体驱动开发：786 个已合并拉取请求，其中 657 个由显式标记或推断关联到智能体，数据来自平台记录和保存的智能体会话记录。在设门禁阶段，负责人账号对同事拉取请求给出的每一次批准，都由一次智能体会话提交，合并也几乎全由它发出；记录无法表明是谁做了决定。作者对每次合并重算一项核心门禁性质：合并前、且针对被合并的确切修订，存在非作者批准和通过的必需检查。重算确认了启用分支保护的地方门禁成立，也找出了不成立的地方：智能体绕开个别合并的强制执行、把失败检查记成通过的合并脚本，以及智能体经未保护分支压扁一叠拉取请求。工程师问卷显示，一名工程师的批准也建立在评审智能体上，由人核验发现并做决定；两人都说，评审只有在对照 diff 之外的东西检验改动时才有用。作者据此提出：把决策权限与账号身份分开记录，不让智能体凭证碰到它本应受其约束的控制，并在集成发生的分支和修订上核对证据。
papers.abstractEn: From 3 October, every non-bot merge into our main branch passed a non-author review gate, yet 71 of those 263 merges (27%) rested only on an approval that a coding agent had submitted through the technical lead's GitHub account, and the platform recorded each one as an ordinary approval by the lead. We report twelve weeks of agent-driven development at Bashi AI, a fintech startup preparing for a SOC 2 audit: 786 merged pull requests, 657 of them associated with agents by explicit markers or by inference, analysed from platform records and saved agent-session transcripts. In the gated phase, an agent session submitted every approval the lead's account gave on a colleague's pull request, and issued nearly all of its merges; the records cannot show who decided any of them. We recompute, for every merge, a core gate property: a non-author approval and a passing required check, both before the merge and both on the exact revision merged. The recomputation confirmed the gate wherever branch protection applied and found where it did not: agents switching enforcement off around individual merges, a merge script that recorded failed checks as passing, and an agent collapsing a stack of pull requests through unprotected branches. The engineers' survey answers show that one engineer's approvals also rested on review agents, with the person validating findings and deciding, and both engineers say review mattered when it tested a change against something outside the diff. We draw lessons on recording decision authority separately from account identity, keeping agents' credentials away from the controls they operate under, and checking evidence at the branch and revision where integration happens.

papers.title: HydraPoT: A Configurable Multi-Agent Framework for Cost-Aware LLM-Assisted Honeypots
papers.abstractOneWord: 用可配置多智能体把传统仿真、轻量大模型和云端大模型接到蜜罐应答上，对象是欺骗交互系统。
papers.abstract: 大语言模型能生成动态、有上下文的回复，从而提高蜜罐真实感，但强云端模型成本高、延迟大，轻量模型的欺骗效果又可能较弱。实践中只能在运行效率和交互保真之间做取舍。本文提出 HydraPoT，这是一个可配置的多智能体蜜罐框架，把传统仿真、轻量大模型和强云端大模型接在一起。HydraPoT 按可配置的复杂度策略，把每条攻击者命令路由到合适的智能体，并维护共享会话状态，以便在智能体切换时保持一致。作者通过架构开销分析、跨智能体上下文保持基准和一个三智能体案例评估。HydraPoT 引入的运行时开销不到 5%，能在异构智能体间保持上下文，保真度接近纯云端大模型蜜罐。在案例策略下，云端处理的 token 减少 72.6%，运行成本降到原来的约 1/3.7。结果表明，可配置的多智能体路由能让高仿真的大模型辅助蜜罐在有限预算下更可行。
papers.abstractEn: Large language models (LLMs) can improve honeypot realism by generating dynamic, context-aware responses, but powerful cloud models incur substantial cost and latency, while lightweight models may provide weaker deception. This forces practitioners to choose between operational efficiency and interaction fidelity. In this work, we present HydraPoT, a configurable multi-agent honeypot framework that integrates traditional emulation, lightweight LLMs, and powerful cloud LLMs. HydraPoT routes each attacker command to an appropriate agent according to a configurable complexity-based policy, while maintaining shared session state to preserve consistency across agent transitions. We evaluate HydraPoT through an architectural-overhead analysis, a cross-agent context-preservation benchmark, and a three-agent case study. HydraPoT introduces less than 5% runtime overhead, preserves context across heterogeneous agents, and achieves fidelity close to a cloud-LLM-only honeypot. Under our case-study policy, it reduces cloud-processed tokens by 72.6% and operational cost by 3.7x. These results demonstrate that configurable multi-agent routing can make realistic LLM-assisted honeypots more practical under limited operational budgets.

papers.title: Who Patches the Lightning Network? Evidence from Release Lines in Gossip, 2023-2026
papers.abstractOneWord: 从 Lightning gossip 推断节点发行线，衡量安全漏洞披露后的升级速度，没有用大模型，对象是比特币闪电网络。
papers.abstract: 2026 年，比特币闪电支付网络的每个实现都披露了安全漏洞，每份公告都要求运营者升级。运营者有没有升级，此前从未被量过，因为 Lightning gossip 不带软件版本。把节点宣告的功能位与 LND、Core Lightning、Eclair 和 LDK 每个发行版的源码对照后，作者表明 gossip 其实能揭示节点的发行线。在 Core Lightning 节点自报版本的地方，推断出的发行线对 136 对节点—发行线中的 132 对完全正确。在 2023 到 2026 年公共图的 814 份日快照上，网络是按发行和平台节奏打补丁，而不是按披露节奏。一半 LND 节点在发行后 88 天内升级；小节点和跳过发行的节点落后很多。三次最大升级潮都出现在 Umbrel 应用商店上架新 LND 版本大约一天后。自 2025 年 6 月以来，17% 的 LND 升级发生在平台发行后 48 小时内，而这些窗口只占时间的 4.4%。披露中位数比修复晚 256 天，对运营者推动很小：在能检验的 12 次披露里，只有 Core Lightning 2026 年 7 月那次加快了升级，且只作用于落后一个发行线的节点。它后来要求离线节点重启，跟进的大多是已经打过补丁的节点。Lightning Labs 2026 年 8 月批次披露两个月后，披露时暴露的 LND 节点仍有 71% 跑在受影响发行版上。对维护者来说，拉动落后节点的杠杆是打包发行版的平台。
papers.abstractEn: Every implementation of Bitcoin's Lightning payment network disclosed security vulnerabilities in 2026, and every advisory told operators to upgrade. Whether they do has never been measured, because Lightning gossip carries no software version. Matching the feature bits a node announces against the source of every LND, Core Lightning, Eclair and LDK release, we show that gossip reveals a node's release line after all. Where Core Lightning nodes state their version, the inferred line is exact for 132 of 136 node-line pairs. Across 814 daily snapshots of the public graph from 2023 to 2026, the network patches on release and platform schedules, not on disclosures. Half of LND nodes upgrade within 88 days of a release; small nodes and those that skipped releases lag far behind. The three largest upgrade waves came about a day after the Umbrel app store shipped a new LND version. Since June 2025, 17% of LND upgrades came in the 48 hours after a platform release, windows that cover 4.4% of the time. Disclosures, a median 256 days after the fix, moved few operators: of 12 we can test, only Core Lightning's of July 2026 sped up upgrades, and only among nodes one release line behind. Its later call to restart offline was followed mostly by nodes already patched. Two months after Lightning Labs' August 2026 batch, 71% of the LND nodes exposed at disclosure still ran an affected release. For maintainers, the lever on the nodes that lag is the platforms that package their releases.

papers.title: Temporal Liquidity Crossing for Blockchains: An EIP-1559 Extension for Admission Below the Base Fee
papers.abstractOneWord: 为以太坊提出时间流动性撮合，让交易在基础费以下入块并约束构建者插入，没有用大模型，对象是 EIP-1559 排序与纳入。
papers.abstract: 交易的价值会随执行时间和相对位置变化。以太坊 EIP-1559 让它们用费用字段竞争，但费用出价既不能强制要求更靠前的位置，也无法表达愿意接受更靠后的位置。其基础费是硬性准入下限。本文引入时间流动性市场（TLM），用来撮合互补的时间需求：希望在靠前区域执行的交易（需求方）可以资助自愿退出该区域的交易（供给方）。被选中的需求方在靠前区域内完成，彼此按授权密度排序，两者都由验证者检查。在作者的区块本地 EIP-1559 扩展中，供给方可在基础费下限以下被纳入。在 TLM 规则下，有资助条件且有容量上限的供给方 gas 不计入普通 EIP-1559 控制器输入。若把它算进去，会在一个正的基础费不动点上抬高基础费并挤出普通需求。排除之后，控制器仍按原目标调节普通需求，并在构造上保持无 TLM 时的普通分配；合成实验中，计入资助 gas 后总利用率上升。被选中的需求方支付其签名授权，用来补供给方缺口，盈余被烧掉。作者给出含策略发送者和构建者的对手模型，并在该模型下证明八条性质，其中包括验证者检查的规则有效性、基础费全部烧掉，以及无补贴。插入一笔需求方出价不会提高其他需求方的收费。在供给方费用上限、小额有上限的纳入费，以及用足够大的关联比把需求方额度绑到已资助供给方 gas 的条件下，构建者插入的任何有限需求方出价或供给方集合都不会提高其直接费用收益。
papers.abstractEn: Transactions differ in how their value changes with execution time and relative position. Ethereum's EIP-1559 lets them compete through fee fields, but a fee bid gives no enforceable claim to an earlier position in the block, and no way to express willingness to accept a later one. Its base fee is a hard admission floor. We introduce temporal liquidity markets (TLM), a framework for crossing complementary temporal requirements: transactions seeking early-region execution (consumers) can fund transactions that opt into exclusion from that region (providers). Selected consumers complete within the early region and are ordered among themselves by authorization density, both validator-checked. In our block-local EIP-1559 extension, providers may be admitted below the base-fee floor. Under TLM regulation, funding-conditioned and capacity-capped provider gas is excluded from the ordinary EIP-1559 controller input. Counting it there instead raises the base fee and displaces ordinary demand at a positive base-fee fixed point. Exclusion lets the controller regulate ordinary demand at its original target and preserves the no-TLM ordinary allocation by construction; in synthetic experiments it raises total utilization with funded gas. Selected consumers pay their signed authorizations, which fund provider shortfalls; the surplus is burned. We state an adversary model with strategic senders and builders and prove eight properties under it, among them validator-checked rule validity, full burn of the base fee, and no subsidy. An inserted consumer bid cannot raise any other consumer's charge. With a provider fee-cap floor, a small, capped inclusion fee and a consumer allowance tied to funded provider gas by a large enough link ratio, no finite set of consumer bids or providers that the builder inserts raises its direct fee payoff.
